description: Divisional Secretariate - Hanguranketha - The Historic Sri Maha Vishnu Temple Esala Perahara will be held from 15th September to 30th 2023
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the scheduling of a religious procession (Hanguranketha Sri Maha Vishnu Temple Procession) pursuant to orders made under the Pilgrimage Ordinance Chapter 175. It involves the implementation of a legal ordinance and regulatory framework for conducting religious processions, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter rather than a government personnel/structure announcement or other specialized category.
